purpose: Syntactic complexity: how far dependents sit from their heads (larger = more embedded, non-local structure).
equation: mean over non-ROOT tokens of |token_index - head_index| per document.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.38); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Average depth of syntactic nesting per sentence.
equation: per sentence: longest ROOT-to-leaf path in the dependency tree; averaged over sentences.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.33); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Deepest syntactic nesting reached in the document.
equation: maximum over sentences of the longest ROOT-to-leaf path.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.06); significant in 8 of 8 tests

equation: count of subordinating arcs (advcl, relcl, acl, acl:relcl, csubj, csubj:pass, ccomp) / number of sentences.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 0.89); significant in 8 of 8 tests

equation: number of spaCy-segmented sentences in the document.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.94); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Length-robust lexical diversity (vocabulary variety independent of text length).
equation: bidirectional Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity: mean token-run length keeping sequential TTR > 0.72, averaged forward+backward (McCarthy & Jarvis 2010).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.80); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Length-robust vocabulary richness via a sliding window.
equation: mean of type-token ratio computed over every 100-token window.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.35); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Raw vocabulary richness (sensitive to text length).
equation: unique lowercased alpha tokens / total alpha tokens.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.67); significant in 7 of 8 tests

purpose: Proportion of grammatical (closed-class) words vs content words.
equation: alpha tokens found in a Swedish function-word list / total alpha tokens.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 0.87); significant in 6 of 8 tests

equation: repeated bigram occurrences / total bigrams over alpha tokens (repeated = sum of count-1 for bigrams occurring more than once).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.31); significant in 8 of 8 tests

equation: repeated trigram occurrences / total trigrams over alpha tokens.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 0.88); significant in 6 of 8 tests

purpose: Comma usage; higher = more clause chaining / listing.
equation: count of ',' in raw text / non-space tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.67); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Sentence-final punctuation density (inversely tracks sentence length).
equation: count of '.' / non-space tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 2.32); significant in 8 of 8 tests

equation: count of ';' / non-space tokens * 100.
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.45); significant in 7 of 8 tests

equation: count of ':' / non-space tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.29); significant in 7 of 8 tests

equation: (count of em-dash + count of en-dash) / non-space tokens * 100.
summary: LLM > Human; up to medium effect (|dz|max 0.78); significant in 7 of 8 tests

equation: count of '!' / non-space tokens * 100 (informal only).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.23); significant in 4 of 4 tests

equation: count of '?' / non-space tokens * 100 (informal only).
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.29); significant in 3 of 4 tests

equation: count of '...' / non-space tokens * 100 (informal only).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.16); significant in 4 of 4 tests

purpose: Epistemic mitigation: markers reducing commitment (uncertainty, approximation, softening).
equation: matches of the 65-form hedge lexicon (case-insensitive; multi-word entries matched as non-overlapping phrases, longest first; polysemous items POS-gated) / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.03); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Absolute number of hedge markers in the document.
equation: number of hedge-lexicon matches.
summary: LLM > Human; up to large effect (|dz|max 1.61); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Written-leaning hedging (e.g. sannolikt, torde, i viss man).
equation: hedge matches tagged register = formal / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.02); significant in 2 of 8 tests

equation: count of register = formal hedge matches.
summary: LLM > Human; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.19); significant in 4 of 8 tests

purpose: Register-neutral hedging (e.g. kanske, kan, tror, ungefar).
equation: hedge matches tagged register = neutral / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 0.89); significant in 8 of 8 tests

equation: count of register = neutral hedge matches.
summary: LLM > Human; up to large effect (|dz|max 1.25); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Spoken-leaning hedging (e.g. typ, ba, liksom, gissar).
equation: hedge matches tagged register = informal / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to medium effect (|dz|max 0.63); significant in 7 of 8 tests

equation: count of register = informal hedge matches.
summary: LLM > Human; up to large effect (|dz|max 1.72); significant in 7 of 8 tests

purpose: Intensifiers that amplify force (e.g. valdigt, verkligen, helt).
equation: booster-lexicon matches (case-insensitive whole-word) / alpha tokens * 100 (informal only).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.22); significant in 4 of 4 tests

equation: number of booster-lexicon matches (informal only).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to medium effect (|dz|max 0.71); significant in 4 of 4 tests

purpose: Frequency of negation markers (inte, ej, aldrig, ingen ...).
equation: negation-lexicon matches (case-insensitive whole-word) / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to medium effect (|dz|max 0.57); significant in 6 of 8 tests

equation: number of negation-lexicon matches.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 1.07); significant in 7 of 8 tests

purpose: How pervasive negation is across sentences (vs concentrated in a few).
equation: fraction of sentences containing at least one negation token.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to large effect (|dz|max 0.82); significant in 7 of 8 tests

purpose: Explicit marking of the speaker's knowledge state (verkar, tror, troligen ...).
equation: epistemic-lexicon matches (case-insensitive whole-word) / alpha tokens * 100.
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.48); significant in 6 of 8 tests

equation: number of epistemic-lexicon matches.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.42); significant in 6 of 8 tests

purpose: Interactional modal particles (ju, val, nog, faktiskt ...); spoken register.
equation: discourse-particle-lexicon matches (case-insensitive whole-word) / alpha tokens * 100 (informal only).
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.36); significant in 2 of 4 tests

equation: number of discourse-particle-lexicon matches (informal only).
summary: LLM > Human; up to large effect (|dz|max 0.93); significant in 3 of 4 tests

equation: number of alphabetic spaCy tokens.
summary: LLM > Human; up to large effect (|dz|max 1.53); significant in 8 of 8 tests

purpose: Overall entity naming = concreteness / specificity of reference.
equation: per document: (total spaCy entities / token length) * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to medium effect (|dz|max 0.57); significant in 7 of 8 tests

purpose: Naming of geographic places (cities, countries, landmarks).
equation: per document: (count of LOC entities / token length) * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.35); significant in 5 of 8 tests

equation: per document: (count of PRS entities / token length) * 100.
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.35); significant in 7 of 8 tests

equation: per document: (count of ORG entities / token length) * 100.
summary: mixed (direction varies by condition); up to small effect (|dz|max 0.37); significant in 5 of 8 tests

equation: per document: (count of TME entities / token length) * 100.
summary: Human > LLM; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.23); significant in 5 of 8 tests

purpose: Named works of art and artefacts.
equation: per document: (count of WRK entities / token length) * 100.
summary: LLM > Human; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.05); significant in 1 of 8 tests

equation: per document: (count of MSR entities / token length) * 100.
summary: no significant human/LLM difference

equation: per document: (count of OBJ entities / token length) * 100.
summary: LLM > Human; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.05); significant in 2 of 8 tests

equation: per document: (count of EVN entities / token length) * 100.
summary: LLM > Human; up to small effect (|dz|max 0.05); significant in 1 of 8 tests
